doc: map_plan's output (design/map.md): the macro grid (each node's height, parcel, and water), the network routed and graded, the rivers, the sites' places, the chunks, the boundary's hull, and the report.

fields.name: gx
fields.doc: The grid's first node: x, metres.

fields.name: parcel_ids
fields.doc: Each node's parcel (65535 outside the map).

fields.name: water
fields.doc: Each node's water level, metres (-1000: dry).

fields.name: outline
fields.doc: The map's outline, its shape's control points.

fields.name: road_of
fields.doc: Each segment's link (an index into the links; rivers: 65536 + river).

fields.name: chunk_q
fields.doc: Each chunk's first cell: axial q.

fields.name: hull
fields.doc: The ring outside the map for its boundary, with its exits.

fields.name: steepest_grade
fields.doc: The steepest grade along a link, rise over run.
